decisions.decision: Sidecar = the shipped ./start-cache-server JS action as a background: step per job (committed bundle, no build-before-sidecar), replicating the proven consumer-smoke pattern.

CORRECTED trust mechanism: every wired job (push AND pull_request) MUST pass GITHUB_TOKEN to ./start-cache-server and MUST NOT be push-gated. selectBackend returns the writable backend on PR too; read-only is platform-enforced. Without a token it degrades to the empty in-memory backend and reads/writes nothing.
decisions.rationale: Code-traced in trust.ts/select-backend.ts; verified by the plan-checker.
